title: Collabora Online, Built-in CODE Server: attackers can run commands on it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 30 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.2). The exploit prediction score is 73%.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Documents and collaboration
category.why: It holds shared documents and internal pages.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your provider whether they have.

summary: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 26, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
